scripts.setup: yarn install --frozen-lockfile && yarn --cwd server install --frozen-lockfile && yarn --cwd client install --frozen-lockfile && yarn --cwd docs install --frozen-lockfile && yarn --cwd server ensure-cache && yarn --cwd server build-collision
scripts.start:vanilla: yarn concurrently --kill-others --names world-1,client "yarn --cwd server start" "yarn --cwd client start"
scripts.server: yarn --cwd server ensure-cache && yarn concurrently --kill-others --names world-1,world-2 "yarn --cwd server start:world --world=1" "yarn --cwd server start:world --world=2"
scripts.check: yarn typecheck && yarn test && yarn docs:build
scripts.typecheck: yarn --cwd server typecheck && yarn --cwd client typecheck
scripts.typecheck:all: yarn --cwd server typecheck:all && yarn --cwd client typecheck:all
scripts.test: yarn --cwd server test && yarn --cwd client test
scripts.test:all: yarn --cwd server test:all && yarn --cwd client test:all
scripts.test:cache: yarn --cwd server test:cache && yarn --cwd client test:cache
